fields.Name: T131 - Action Explorer Category Tree Filter
fields.Description: Bespoke tree-panel selection + descendant-category filtering (getDescendantCategoryIds/applyFilters) and breadcrumb sync — not AG-Grid column filtering.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. The Explorer has a category tree panel on the LEFT. Click a category node in that tree and verify the main action list RESPONDS — it narrows to actions in that category (and its sub-categories), the breadcrumb updates to show the selected category, OR a clear 'no actions match' empty-state appears. Then click back to 'All' (root/all categories) and verify the full list returns. The list responding to the category selection is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: A category tree/sidebar is visible on the left of the Explorer
Selecting a category narrows the action list to that category OR shows a valid empty-state, and the breadcrumb/selection reflects the chosen category
Returning to 'All' categories restores the broader list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
